newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan chip makers group net profit seen down - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan chip makers group net profit seen down - paper.

text.p: Group net profits of Japan's five largest semiconductor makers in the year to March 31, 1997 are expected to fall from the year ago due to the sluggish chip market, the economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Wednesday.

It said group net profit of NEC Corp in 1996/97 would drop nine percent from a year ago to about 70 billion yen. The paper expected 1996/97 group net profit of Mitsubishi Electric Corp would be about 45 billion yen, down 24 percent from the year ago.
The companies were not immediately available for comment.
